snippet.title: Rock'n Tread (Arcade 1999) [Playthrough/Longplay]
snippet.description:
Rock Tread is a one player rhythm game published by Jaleco in 1999
Similar to beatmania but with simpler interface one button and one pedal.

00:00:00 Title/Insert Coin
00:00:28 1st Stage (Hungry Spider)
00:02:23 2nd Stage (Departures)
00:04:27 Final Stage (Masquerade)
00:06:17 Extra Stage (Take on me)
00:08:00 Credits
